messages:
incident-bot: P1 PAGING: tenant-specific quality regression detected. tenant=zenith-global (VPC dedicated pool). metric=QA_score drop > 30% vs baseline for redwood-v2-13b@q5_beta since 2026-03-12T02:02Z. Affected qps ~9. Paging @maria (oncall).

maria (oncall): ack. I'm on it. brief: are we seeing this across all models or only q-profile variants?

raj (core-ml): only q5_beta so far. we rolled q5_beta to several enterprise tenants last week. suspect quantization change introduced scaling drift for longer-context distributions.

kevin (infra): pulling pool logs for pool id dp-eu-central-zen-01. will also check recent maintenance window at 01:45Z.

alice (CSM): support ticket #9012. Customer says outputs are "weirdly curt" and missing paragraphs in mid-output. Demo scheduled in 3 hours. they've escalated.

kevin (infra): logs snippet: ```
[2026-03-12T02:01:58Z] tenant=tenant-zenith-998 request=rid-77a1 model=redwood-v2-13b profile=q5_beta tokens_out=200 latency=140ms
[2026-03-12T02:01:59Z] inference: truncated=true entropy_drop=true
```

raj (core-ml): kv cache miss spikes observed too? that can exacerbate quant errors.

sasha (runtime): yes, seeing kv-cache warm misses post infra restart during maintenance. combined with a new quant kernel that reduced dynamic range could cause mid-output collapse.

maria (oncall): we need immediate mitigation that doesn't disrupt tenant SLA more than necessary. options?

raj (core-ml): ranked mitigations:
- 1) tenant-scoped rollback to previous quant profile q4_stable (fast, targeted).
- 2) route tenant to fp16 build `redwood-v2-13b-fp16@r202602` (safe, increased memory/cost).
- 3) apply temporary post-processing filler heuristic to detect truncation and re-query with smaller max_new_tokens (hacky).

kevin (infra): runtime supports per-tenant profile overrides. we can do option 1 now. Sasha, can you initiate a 5% canary then ramp?

sasha (runtime): yes. ops command: ```bash
curl -X POST "https://ops-api.internal/rollouts/v1/tenants/tenant-zenith-998/override" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v2-13b","profile":"q4_stable","reason":"rollback-quant-q5_beta-regression","requested_by":"maria"}'
```
Canary expected to show effect within ~20-30s.

maria (oncall): do the canary. kevin please monitor QA metric and error traces. alice, keep customer updated that mitigation is being applied.

kevin (infra): starting canary 5% -> `deploy-bot` will report.

deploy-bot: rollout start -> id=roll-8822, tenant=tenant-zenith-998, from=q5_beta -> to=q4_stable, canary=5%

kevin (infra): canary health check 40s: sample set shows QA_score restored to baseline for canary requests, no truncations observed. latency within expected. ramping to 100%.

deploy-bot: rollout 5% -> 100% complete. id=roll-8822 status=successful.

raj (core-ml): running quick local eval on repro set. early diffs look like q5_beta introduced a subtle bias in softmax scaling across tokens 64-128; q4_stable matches expected. I'll collect diffs and candidate PR to revert the problematic kernel commit.

alice (CSM): Customer re-ran demo prompts and reports immediate improvement. they still want root cause and timeline for permanent fix. asking for written summary to share with partners.

maria (oncall): next tasks:
- Raj: full RCA with failing diffs, commit hashes, and recommended long-term fix vs revert. ETA 3-4h.
- Sasha/Infra: add a dedicated regression check in deployment pipeline for per-tenant quant profiles with longer-context prompts and KV-warm scenarios. ETA 6-8h for rule rollout.
- Oncall: continue monitoring for 1 hour, then handoff to daytime oncall.

raj (core-ml): note candidate commit e3c9fd in quant-kernels that changed mantissa clipping heuristics. running ablation now. will attach failing examples and a suggested unit test to prevent regression.

sasha (runtime): also adding a temporary alert for tenant-specific QA drop >15% post-profile-change. should reduce time-to-detect for similar incidents.

maria (oncall): handing off to @sasha in 50 minutes. Sasha will own until RCA posted. I'll update incident status to customer-facing once Raj posts RCA.

sasha (runtime): ack. tagging postmortem channel #postmortems and #devops-playbooks for checklist updates.

alice (CSM): sending customer a mitigation note: "We've applied a targeted rollback of your model quant profile which restored output quality. Engineering is investigating root cause and will post a summary within 4 hours."

maria (oncall): closing the urgent pager. thread remains open for RCA and follow-ups. :white_check_mark:

raj (core-ml): follow-up note for RCA: include repro commands, diff of softmax scaling tests, and proposed CI gate. I'll paste ablation outputs in this thread when ready.
